findings: HSI contract is NOT_PROVIDED in the manifest, creating a gap in traceability as per upstream_gaps.md.

The software requirements do not specify failure handling, reset/startup behavior or safe states. The IWDG LL driver requirements (SWR-001 through SWR-019) only define register-level operations and do
SWR-017 states the driver shall occupy at most 4096 bytes of flash, but no evidence is provided in the checked sources that this constraint is explicitly measured or verified.
SWR-018 states the driver shall use at most 64 bytes of static RAM, but no evidence is provided in the checked sources that this constraint is explicitly measured or verified.
SWR-019 states the driver shall use at most 128 bytes of stack for any public API call, but no evidence is provided in the checked sources that this constraint is explicitly measured or verified.
